_doc: Chart narrative contract for index.html. Tokens {n}, {cutExp}, {cutPrep}, {slope}, {r2}, {nReg}, {nWhitespace}, {nExposed}, {sharePct}, {nL1}, {nLinkedWriters}, {nLinkedAssets} resolved at build time in harness/build_frontend.py and harness/frontend/assemble.py.

table_rankings.title: Margin of Safety
table_rankings.stats: Preparedness − Exposure · {sharePct}% measured/disclosed · read as posture, not pecking order

bench_mos.title: Scores across the carrier field
bench_mos.lede: Bars compare insurers, syndicates, MGAs, brokers and assets on the active metric — relative placement inside a segment, not a standalone rating.
bench_mos.read: Switch metric to see whether an entity leads on exposure, preparedness, margin, or measured share.
bench_mos.stats: Filtered slice · click any bar for detail
bench_mos.so_what: Useful for contrast inside a layer while measured share remains below gate.

term_regression.title: MoS vs measured share
term_regression.lede: Each dot plots margin against how much of that margin rests on registers and filings rather than research prior.
term_regression.read: A positive slope would mean higher margin correlates with harder evidence — the opposite suggests the most exposed names are also the least measured.
term_regression.stats: Slope {slope} pp/point · R² {r2} · n = {nReg} · gate {sharePct}% measured
term_regression.so_what: Until measured share rises, rank order should be read as directional — honest about what is still outside-in.

term_scoreboard.title: Scoreboards by layer and book
term_scoreboard.lede: Mean margin aggregated by structural layer or by book segment tag.
term_scoreboard.read: Toggle layer vs segment to see whether the gap is structural (L1–L4) or thematic (energy, data-centre, parametric).
term_scoreboard.stats: In-sample means · click a bar to filter the scatter
term_scoreboard.so_what: Segment gaps flag where product fit has not caught up to exposure concentration.

term_strategy.title: Strategy map · L1 carriers
term_strategy.lede: L1 carriers on the same exposure × preparedness plane as the universe scatter.
term_strategy.read: Distance from the median cuts shows strategic posture — earning the bet, exposed to it, sidelined, or in whitespace.
term_strategy.so_what: Whitespace here means rated capacity and product infrastructure not yet deployed on availability risk.

term_alpha.title: Whitespace surplus
term_alpha.lede: Entities high on preparedness, low on exposure — structural capacity the damage view still treats as benign.
term_alpha.read: Gap column is preparedness minus exposure within the whitespace quadrant only.
term_alpha.stats: Whitespace slice · n varies by filter
term_alpha.so_what: The commercial question is deployment timing: who writes availability cover before the queue reprices.

term_compare.title: Head-to-head carriers
term_compare.lede: Pick two L1 carriers and compare margin, axes, measured share and quadrant side by side.
term_compare.read: Useful for syndicate vs composite or MGA-parent contrasts — same construct, different posture.
term_compare.stats: Compare pool · L1 carriers with scored profiles
term_compare.so_what: Relative placement matters more than absolute level while the index remains provisional.

term_swarm.title: Linked assets by carrier
term_swarm.lede: Each dot is a linked L3 asset positioned by its own margin — select a writer to inspect portfolio dispersion against their headline score.
term_swarm.read: Dashed vertical line marks the writer's own MoS. Compare whether parent preparedness matches asset-level non-firm intensity.
term_swarm.stats: {nLinkedWriters} writers with coverage evidence · {nLinkedAssets} linked assets
term_swarm.so_what: Diversified carriers can look prepared at L1 while linked assets concentrate curtailment risk.

term_quad_stack.title: Quadrant mix by carrier
term_quad_stack.lede: Stacked bars show what share of each carrier's linked book falls in each quadrant.
term_quad_stack.read: 100% stacked view — compare book shape, not absolute size.
term_quad_stack.stats: {nLinkedWriters} writers · {nLinkedAssets} linked assets · evidence from coverage map
term_quad_stack.so_what: A carrier earning it at L1 with an exposed L3 book is a different risk than the headline score suggests.

terminal_hub.title: Scores, segments & whitespace surplus
terminal_hub.lede: Dense analytics on the scored universe — regression, layer and segment scoreboards, carrier strategy map, whitespace slice, and head-to-head compare. Each panel follows the same read → chart → stats → so what structure as the thesis charts.
